photos-under-fixed-heading.title: Slide the photos beneath a fixed heading
photos-under-fixed-heading.moves: Adjacent photos translate together on one horizontally clipped rail.
photos-under-fixed-heading.fixed: The heading, viewport, divider and supporting footer stay in place.
photos-under-fixed-heading.notice: The next photo comes into view while the place and surrounding context remain easy to read.
photos-under-fixed-heading.fits: Browse pictures inside a place or album surface with persistent labels. Use the separate UI adapter variant for inline conversation paging.

heading-over-fixed-photos.title: Slide a heading over still photos
heading-over-fixed-photos.moves: The heading text glides within its own clipped band.
heading-over-fixed-photos.fixed: Photo positions, their crop, the heading backdrop and bottom caption hold still.
heading-over-fixed-photos.notice: The viewer can compare the same images while the title establishes a new emphasis.
heading-over-fixed-photos.fits: Reposition an editorial label over stationary evidence or retain a fixed gallery frame.

conversation-handoff.title: Send an outgoing text and receive a reply
conversation-handoff.moves: Draft characters arrive in the composer, transfer into an outgoing blue bubble, and an incoming gray reply arrives after a pause.
conversation-handoff.fixed: The phone, conversation header, composer field and reading area stay in place.
conversation-handoff.notice: An outgoing request leads to an incoming answer. The quiet gap separates the two actors.
conversation-handoff.fits: Show a short request and reply in the same conversation, with composer send and inbound text.

composer-type.title: Type a draft in place
composer-type.moves: The composer gains characters at uneven intervals as the caret advances.
composer-type.fixed: The draft field, transcript, heading, and phone viewport are stationary.
composer-type.notice: A person is building a draft before any message is sent.
composer-type.fits: Show human input or let the viewer read the prompt as it is typed.

draft-send-flight.title: Send from the composer into history
draft-send-flight.moves: The draft box collapses toward its right edge while the outgoing balloon rises, slightly overshoots, then settles into its transcript slot.
draft-send-flight.fixed: The conversation heading, prior reply, and composer field stay fixed. The send control disappears at the trigger.
draft-send-flight.notice: The text the viewer just read in the field becomes a real outgoing message.
draft-send-flight.fits: Establish the exact send moment without cutting away from the conversation.

typing-indicator-cycle.title: Cycle an incoming typing indicator
typing-indicator-cycle.moves: Three dots lift and dim in staggered phases inside a stationary bubble.
typing-indicator-cycle.fixed: The dots’ container, prior outgoing message, composer and heading.
typing-indicator-cycle.notice: The recipient is working on a reply, with no text to read yet.
typing-indicator-cycle.fits: A short conversational pause before the other person answers.

reply-makes-room.title: Make room for a whole incoming reply
reply-makes-room.moves: The previous rows lift together. The complete incoming reply rises a shorter distance into the bottom slot.
reply-makes-room.fixed: The header, composer, and bottom resting line of the transcript.
reply-makes-room.notice: The other participant has answered and the conversation advances to the latest message.
reply-makes-room.fits: A reply arrives in an already populated conversation.

delivery-receipt-handoff.title: Move the delivery receipt to the latest send
delivery-receipt-handoff.moves: The old receipt fades under the first bubble. The latest bubble rises toward its final slot as its receipt resolves.
delivery-receipt-handoff.fixed: The first bubble, the composer and the conversation heading.
delivery-receipt-handoff.notice: The delivery status belongs to the latest sent item.
delivery-receipt-handoff.fits: Track where a confirmation label lives after a new outgoing item is acknowledged.

long-press-actions.title: Reveal actions around a pressed message
long-press-actions.moves: Context dims while the option tray opens below the held row and the reaction rail grows above it.
long-press-actions.fixed: The selected message stays centered on its original slot throughout the reveal.
long-press-actions.notice: The press selects one message and exposes possible actions.
long-press-actions.fits: Introduce options tied to a single message without implying a choice has happened.

reaction-attach.title: Attach a chosen reaction to its message
reaction-attach.moves: The selected reaction follows a curved approach, shrinks into a corner badge and settles as the nearby text row makes room.
reaction-attach.fixed: Message copy, heading and composer. Earlier messages stay put.
reaction-attach.notice: The chosen response belongs to this one message and remains attached after the picker goes away.
reaction-attach.fits: Show the result of choosing a reaction once the available choices are understood.

transcript-timestamp-peek.title: Peek at timestamps by dragging the transcript
transcript-timestamp-peek.moves: Every bubble shifts left once and springs back on release, exposing small times in a stationary gutter.
transcript-timestamp-peek.fixed: Times remain on the trailing edge. The heading, composer, and individual vertical positions stay fixed.
transcript-timestamp-peek.notice: These are times for existing messages, revealed by a temporary drag.
transcript-timestamp-peek.fits: Show when multiple parts of an existing conversation occurred.

swipe-to-quote.title: Swipe one message to quote it
swipe-to-quote.moves: Only the chosen bubble follows the drag. An arrow appears behind it, then the row returns and its quote opens above the composer.
swipe-to-quote.fixed: Other transcript rows, header and reply input position.
swipe-to-quote.notice: The next draft will reply to one specific earlier message.
swipe-to-quote.fits: An answer needs an explicit target in a busy conversation.

inline-thread-open.title: Expand an inline reply thread
inline-thread-open.moves: A connector grows from the parent while two indented replies emerge in sequence. The next unrelated row moves down.
inline-thread-open.fixed: The parent message, heading and composer.
inline-thread-open.notice: Several messages belong under one earlier message, as a readable subthread.
inline-thread-open.fits: Expose a group of existing inline replies while preserving their parent context.

edit-message-reflow.title: Edit a message at its existing position
edit-message-reflow.moves: The original bubble deepens to fit an editable second line. Nearby content reflows and the edit marker appears on commit.
edit-message-reflow.fixed: The same message retains its identity and leading row. The header and main composer do not move.
edit-message-reflow.notice: A previously sent message changes in place and keeps its row in the conversation.
edit-message-reflow.fits: Correct existing text while preserving the surrounding conversation.

undo-send-remove.title: Undo a send and retract its row
undo-send-remove.moves: The outgoing bubble contracts toward its own tail and fades. Nearby rows close the gap, then a quiet history status appears.
undo-send-remove.fixed: The header, composer and surviving messages’ copy.
undo-send-remove.notice: One previously sent message was retracted from the conversation.
undo-send-remove.fits: Show that a mistaken send was undone and what remains afterward.

history-prepend-anchor.title: Load older messages without losing the reading position
history-prepend-anchor.moves: History appears above the visible rows. The rows stay put through insertion and then follow the next drag together.
history-prepend-anchor.fixed: The currently read bubble stays at the same position during insertion. The heading and composer remain fixed throughout.
history-prepend-anchor.notice: Earlier history became available while the current reading position was preserved.
history-prepend-anchor.fits: Demonstrate pagination or a chat-history fetch while keeping the viewer oriented.

jump-to-unread.title: Jump to the first unread message
jump-to-unread.moves: A single controlled scroll advances past intervening rows. The unread divider comes to rest at a predictable spot and the jump control clears.
jump-to-unread.fixed: The reading frame, composer and header stay anchored while the transcript travels.
jump-to-unread.notice: The destination is the beginning of unread content.
jump-to-unread.fits: Skip past older chat history and land on a marked new starting point.

keyboard-focus-reflow.title: Focus the composer and open keyboard space
keyboard-focus-reflow.moves: The keyboard pushes up from below, lifting the composer and the last message to keep both reachable.
keyboard-focus-reflow.fixed: The conversation header and textarea contents. No characters are entered.
keyboard-focus-reflow.notice: The conversation moved into text-entry mode while preserving the latest message.
keyboard-focus-reflow.fits: Show how a reply starts and where the user will type next.

link-preview-upgrade.title: Upgrade a plain link into an inline preview
link-preview-upgrade.moves: The link card extends horizontally and the source metadata slides in behind a clipping boundary.
link-preview-upgrade.fixed: The URL, message row height, adjacent reply, heading and composer.
link-preview-upgrade.notice: The shared link gained a richer preview alongside its original address.
link-preview-upgrade.fits: Play an inline metadata fetch or introduce information contained in an already shared link.

send-failure-retry.title: Signal a failed send and reveal retry
send-failure-retry.moves: One outgoing bubble gives a short damped shake. The retry control and failure status then appear beside and below it.
send-failure-retry.fixed: Existing conversation rows, recipient, heading and composer.
send-failure-retry.notice: The message exists locally and delivery failed. The viewer can retry it.

schedule-send-wheel.title: Set a future send time without sending yet
schedule-send-wheel.moves: A time wheel rolls behind a fixed selection band. The selected time persists in a small schedule chip as the wheel closes.
schedule-send-wheel.fixed: Selection band, draft copy and conversation history.
schedule-send-wheel.notice: The message will be sent later, at the time displayed on the chip.
schedule-send-wheel.fits: Make the distinction between choosing a send time and executing a send visible.

batch-select-messages.title: Select messages for one batch action
batch-select-messages.moves: The transcript shifts to make room for a check rail. Two rows gain checks separately, then an action bar replaces the composer.
batch-select-messages.fixed: Header, transcript order, and each message’s text.
batch-select-messages.notice: Two particular rows are selected for a later shared action.
batch-select-messages.fits: Show deliberate selection across several messages before forwarding or deleting them.

pin-conversation-avatar.title: Promote a conversation into the pinned tray
pin-conversation-avatar.moves: The avatar follows a short arc from its row into the pinned tray. Its old row collapses and lower rows slide up.
pin-conversation-avatar.fixed: The inbox header, the pin lane, and other conversations’ names and preview copy.
pin-conversation-avatar.notice: The same conversation is now reachable from the pinned area.
pin-conversation-avatar.fits: Show a conversation being promoted within the inbox.

camera-push-in.title: Push the camera toward a detail
camera-push-in.moves: The camera plane scales around a chosen detail, taking its neighboring cards toward the edges.
camera-push-in.fixed: The focal point, the cards’ arrangement within the camera plane, and the surrounding frame.
camera-push-in.notice: The detail belongs to the same workspace established at the start.
camera-push-in.fits: Lead into an important control or small result that was hard to read in the overview.

camera-truck-between.title: Pan the camera across neighboring workspaces
camera-truck-between.moves: A horizontal camera pan moves the view between adjacent panels. A small index marks the next destination.
camera-truck-between.fixed: Magnification, destination sizes and spacing, the viewing window, and the surrounding heading.
camera-truck-between.notice: The second view is next to the first on the same plane.
camera-truck-between.fits: Show a connection between adjacent panels or identify the next stop in an established horizontal layout.

depth-parallax.title: Shift foreground, middle and background at different rates
depth-parallax.moves: The foreground crosses quickly, the middle cards move a shorter distance, and the grid barely shifts.
depth-parallax.fixed: The drawing window and the relative arrangement of objects on each plane.
depth-parallax.notice: Different rates disclose depth between established planes.
depth-parallax.fits: Reveal spatial layers or give a lateral product view a credible sense of depth.

rack-focus.title: Transfer focus between two stationary planes
rack-focus.moves: Sharpness shifts from the near card to the far card. The near card softens in place.
rack-focus.fixed: Both cards’ positions and silhouettes, the frame, and the heading.
rack-focus.notice: The subject in the back becomes the point of attention even though its position never changes.
rack-focus.fits: Pass attention between subjects while preserving their positions and sense of depth.

typographic-tracking-contract.title: Draw the letters of a title into reading position
typographic-tracking-contract.moves: Letter spacing contracts toward the center without changing the word or type size.
typographic-tracking-contract.fixed: The title’s center and baseline, its wording, and the axis underneath.
typographic-tracking-contract.notice: Dispersed characters resolve into one readable phrase.
typographic-tracking-contract.fits: Settle a short title at the end of a reveal, especially when the idea is convergence or agreement.

step-indicator-travel.title: Move the active indicator through three fixed steps
step-indicator-travel.moves: An underline travels to the second step, holds, then travels to the third.
step-indicator-travel.fixed: All step labels, the rail, and the explanatory line.
step-indicator-travel.notice: The movement represents progression through an ordered set of stages.
step-indicator-travel.fits: Show a workflow reaching successive checkpoints without moving the actual controls.

metric-wheel-roll.title: Roll a value through a fixed readout window
metric-wheel-roll.moves: Three values roll upward through a narrow clipped readout and stop at the final value.
metric-wheel-roll.fixed: Width and position of the readout, its baseline, and the metric label.
metric-wheel-roll.notice: One metric changes over time, with a marked starting value and a readable final value.
metric-wheel-roll.fits: Represent an increasing count or visibly changing ordinal state in an instrument-like readout.

comparison-bars-grow.title: Grow two comparison bars from a shared baseline
comparison-bars-grow.moves: Both bars grow upward from the same baseline and stop at their own value.
comparison-bars-grow.fixed: The baseline, the target line, and the two category labels.
comparison-bars-grow.notice: The second bar clears the target line while the first falls short in the default example.
comparison-bars-grow.fits: Compare quantitative magnitudes with a shared reference and readable final state.

trend-line-trace.title: Trace a trend through the points of a chart
trend-line-trace.moves: A leading point traverses the chart and leaves the completed segments behind.
trend-line-trace.fixed: Grid lines, axes, and the endpoints of the plotted values.
trend-line-trace.notice: Ordering matters. The retained path makes the direction and reversals legible.
trend-line-trace.fits: Reveal how a trend developed across a series of points.

grid-reflow.title: Reflow four cards while keeping them recognizable
grid-reflow.moves: Each card follows an individual path into a changed grid order.
grid-reflow.fixed: Card copy and proportions, the board, and the heading.
grid-reflow.notice: The same cards survive the layout change, even as reading order shifts.
grid-reflow.fits: Make a changed sort or rearranged layout clear without losing track of the items.

accordion-displaces-row.title: Expand a disclosure and make room for its details
accordion-displaces-row.moves: The first row grows down, its indicator rotates, and the following row makes space below it.
accordion-displaces-row.fixed: The top edge of the first row, the row titles, and the surrounding viewport.
accordion-displaces-row.notice: The details belong to the opening row, and the lower row remains part of the layout.
accordion-displaces-row.fits: Show details disclosed inside a vertically stacked list with physical reflow.

exploded-layer-view.title: Separate a compact assembly into visible layers
exploded-layer-view.moves: Three stacked planes spread diagonally, keeping a shared orientation as their edges separate.
exploded-layer-view.fixed: Each layer’s own geometry, border, and label.
exploded-layer-view.notice: The assembly contains separate working surfaces that belong together.
exploded-layer-view.fits: Explain how a view is composed or which layer handles each responsibility.

spotlight-cross-text.title: Move a spotlight across fixed phrases
spotlight-cross-text.moves: A bounded opening in a dim overlay travels from one phrase to the next.
spotlight-cross-text.fixed: All the text, its position, type, and spacing. The overlay keeps its height.
spotlight-cross-text.notice: The next phrase becomes current while earlier context stays visible in low contrast.
spotlight-cross-text.fits: Direct the eye to different phrases in a fixed diagram or copy layout.

signals-merge-routes.title: Merge two incoming routes into one outgoing result
signals-merge-routes.moves: Two signals travel along separate pathways and combine at the junction. One outgoing packet continues along the shared route.
signals-merge-routes.fixed: The branch geometry, junction, endpoints and labels.
signals-merge-routes.notice: Independent inputs are combined before the result is delivered.
signals-merge-routes.fits: Explain joins, aggregation, or collaboration with a clear point of convergence.

signal-radiation.title: Send concentric signal waves from one point
signal-radiation.moves: Thin rings grow out from one source and fade at successive distances.
signal-radiation.fixed: The source itself, heading, and explanatory text.
signal-radiation.notice: A single originating action propagates outward to its surroundings.
signal-radiation.fits: Show broadcasting, discovery, or a ripple of system activity from one source.

freeze-around-live-detail.title: Freeze surrounding movement while one detail keeps going
freeze-around-live-detail.moves: Peripheral activity stops mid-travel. One point in the center keeps moving to its destination.
freeze-around-live-detail.fixed: The tracks stay fixed throughout. After the stop, all peripheral points hold their exact positions.
freeze-around-live-detail.notice: One process remains relevant while competing activity pauses.
freeze-around-live-detail.fits: Isolate a still-running process in a dense animated wash of other activity.

items-collapse-into-count.title: Convert individual items into a tally
items-collapse-into-count.moves: Each item takes a short arc into a counter, shrinks away at arrival, and advances the count.
items-collapse-into-count.fixed: The count surface, the label underneath it, and the overall framing.
items-collapse-into-count.notice: Every count increase corresponds to one specific arriving item.
items-collapse-into-count.fits: Show completion, aggregation, or the number of processed items.

registered-shape-cut.title: Cut between two contexts on a matched shape
registered-shape-cut.moves: An abrupt cut changes the surrounding shot in one frame. The supporting line appears after the cut.
registered-shape-cut.fixed: The matched action shape, its position and size, and the action wording.
registered-shape-cut.notice: A corresponding action connects two different contexts.
registered-shape-cut.fits: Jump between two contexts while keeping a strong visual point of correspondence.

objects-pass-behind.title: Move two objects behind a fixed foreground cover
objects-pass-behind.moves: The objects travel toward each other, disappear behind a central cover, and emerge on opposite sides.
objects-pass-behind.fixed: The central cover, both travel lanes, and the heading.
objects-pass-behind.notice: The objects continue behind the cover and keep their identities as they reappear.
objects-pass-behind.fits: Demonstrate a handoff through an occluded region or passage on the same plane.

needle-sweeps-threshold.title: Sweep a gauge needle to its measured reading
needle-sweeps-threshold.moves: A single meter pointer rotates about its pivot, overshoots briefly, and settles at the desired reading.
needle-sweeps-threshold.fixed: Gauge ticks, the threshold region, the pivot and the labels.
needle-sweeps-threshold.notice: The shown value falls at a specific point on a bounded scale.
needle-sweeps-threshold.fits: Show one metric crossing a threshold or resolving into a stable reading.

message-wall.title: Bring a wall of messages into view
message-wall.moves: Conversation tiles enter in a stagger while a common camera glides through the wall.
message-wall.fixed: The cells retain their columns; the layout order and each message identity stay readable.
message-wall.fits: Show that a product works across distinct conversations or cases.

app-drawer.title: Raise the app drawer as one clipped sheet
app-drawer.moves: The drawer carries a handle and icons upward together from offscreen.
app-drawer.fixed: The phone header and underlying message remain in place.
app-drawer.notice: The app choices live in a single drawer within the conversation.
app-drawer.fits: Reveal where to find a set of tools or integrations.

identity-morph.title: Morph an identity into an app tile
identity-morph.moves: The surface changes radius, size, and color while two distinct marks exchange at its center.
identity-morph.fixed: The central identity anchor and background plane hold.
identity-morph.notice: The viewer reads the new mark as the same product in a new form.
identity-morph.fits: Introduce an app icon as another expression of an existing identity.

circle-to-panel.title: Grow a small control into a working surface
circle-to-panel.moves: One circle widens into a panel while the corner radius changes; contents appear after the surface has room.
circle-to-panel.fixed: The transformation remains centered on the same stage anchor.
circle-to-panel.notice: The same surface becomes a place to act.
circle-to-panel.fits: Connect a compact affordance with the larger panel it opens.

mini-app-expand.title: Expand a mini-app in the thread
mini-app-expand.moves: An embedded card scales from its bottom anchor into reading size inside its conversation.
mini-app-expand.fixed: The request, composer, phone silhouette, and conversation header hold.
mini-app-expand.notice: The short request and a usable response coexist in the same surface.
mini-app-expand.fits: Show an inline app that remains in the thread while it grows.

selection-confirm.title: Resolve a button press in place
selection-confirm.moves: One control transitions from action color to pressed styling to confirmation wording and color.
selection-confirm.fixed: The button position, geometry and parent card stay fixed.
selection-confirm.notice: The same action visibly succeeds without a route change.
selection-confirm.fits: Confirm a selected option or a completed action in the existing control.

card-orbit.title: Bring a product family into a readable lineup
card-orbit.moves: Independent cards arrive from separate angles with distinct rotations and settle into an ordered row.
card-orbit.fixed: The destination row establishes a common baseline against a stationary field.
card-orbit.notice: Distinct offerings become a set while retaining their labels.
card-orbit.fits: Introduce a small product family with breadth and comparable visual weight.

messages-attachment-stack.title: Swipe the front attachment off a stack
messages-attachment-stack.moves: The top card translates and rotates off the deck; the next card advances in depth and turns back toward zero.
messages-attachment-stack.fixed: The attachment count, conversation label, composer, and backdrop remain fixed.
messages-attachment-stack.notice: The photos are separate cards in one attachment, and the next card moves into the lead slot.
messages-attachment-stack.fits: Show one-at-a-time browsing with an authored inline stack of overlapping attachments.

inline-card-expand.title: Raise a detail sheet above a dimmed conversation
inline-card-expand.moves: A distinct grabber and sheet rise together and settle while the chat dims below.
inline-card-expand.fixed: The header and underlying message/card stay put in the conversation.
inline-card-expand.notice: The selected card opens another surface while the thread remains visible underneath.
inline-card-expand.fits: Expose more detail or actions in a temporary sheet while preserving conversation context.

avatar-ring-assemble.title: Gather portraits around centered copy
avatar-ring-assemble.moves: Portraits approach on separate trajectories, sharpen and settle around shrinking headline copy.
avatar-ring-assemble.fixed: The center of the copy remains anchored and the backdrop holds.
avatar-ring-assemble.notice: Independent people converge around a shared idea without shifting the idea’s anchor.
avatar-ring-assemble.fits: Present a group or set of participants around one promise.

tear-perforated-ticket.title: Separate a ticket along its perforation
tear-perforated-ticket.moves: A perforated seam parts left to right as the stub tilts around the still-joined edge, then drops once detached.
tear-perforated-ticket.fixed: The main ticket, its copy and the backdrop stay pinned.
tear-perforated-ticket.notice: The smaller section belonged to the original ticket and is now independently usable.
tear-perforated-ticket.fits: Show a detachable stub or one part becoming independent after separation.

message-pin-landing.title: Carry a location cue from chat to a map pin
message-pin-landing.moves: A dot leaves the inline location cue, travels into the map, and compresses before it becomes an anchored pin.
message-pin-landing.fixed: The question, stage map, route, and heading remain stationary throughout the travel.
message-pin-landing.notice: The viewer connects the original question to an exact place on the map.
message-pin-landing.fits: Turn an address or a location answer into a physical destination while preserving the related question.

photo-open-continuity.title: Thumbnail opens into a viewer
photo-open-continuity.moves: The chosen thumbnail grows and moves into a raised preview while its neighbors dim.
photo-open-continuity.fixed: The other thumbnail boxes, heading, footer, and viewport hold position.
photo-open-continuity.notice: The same selected image is now large enough to inspect.
photo-open-continuity.fits: Open one attachment while preserving its identity and origin in the row.

photo-pinch-detail.title: Pinch into a detail inside the photo
photo-pinch-detail.moves: The picture scales around a focal point inside a clipped viewer as the gesture markers spread.
photo-pinch-detail.fixed: The image window, control below it, heading, and footer hold position.
photo-pinch-detail.notice: The viewer is magnifying the picture inside an existing viewport.
photo-pinch-detail.fits: Give a viewer a closer look while preserving interface context.

photo-crop-reframe.title: Reframe a photo inside a fixed crop
photo-crop-reframe.moves: An oversized picture eases sideways underneath a stationary portrait crop frame.
photo-crop-reframe.fixed: The crop bounds, grid lines, heading, and footer hold position.
photo-crop-reframe.notice: The same image is composed around a different focal point at the same magnification.
photo-crop-reframe.fits: Demonstrate shifting a subject within a thumbnail crop or portrait frame.

photo-compare-wipe.title: Wipe across a registered before/after photo
photo-compare-wipe.moves: A divider increases the visible fraction of the second image from the same crop origin.
photo-compare-wipe.fixed: Both photo grids, the surrounding crop frame, and the outside controls hold position.
photo-compare-wipe.notice: The viewer can compare the two conditions at the same coordinate.
photo-compare-wipe.fits: Compare two versions of the same asset. Supply equally sized and registered before and after images.

photo-album-deal.title: Deal photos from one album stack
photo-album-deal.moves: The three already stacked thumbnails separate on staggered paths and straighten into a row.
photo-album-deal.fixed: Heading, footer, and the album label hold position.
photo-album-deal.notice: The individual images belong to the same combined attachment.
photo-album-deal.fits: Unpack a small set of photos from a single visible stack.

media-video-scrub.title: Scrub to specific points in a media preview
media-video-scrub.moves: The playhead drags forward, pauses, and backtracks; the sample shown in the fixed viewer follows its position.
media-video-scrub.fixed: The preview frame, timeline baseline, and interface chrome hold position.
media-video-scrub.notice: Moving through time changes the viewer while the rest of the UI remains stable.
media-video-scrub.fits: Show seeking instead of playback. Supply ordered stills from the same video as sample frames.

media-trim-range.title: Trim the in and out points independently
media-trim-range.moves: The two range handles advance inward in separate gestures around a fixed filmstrip.
media-trim-range.fixed: The filmstrip image positions, heading, footer, and time axis hold position.
media-trim-range.notice: Only the section between the handles will be kept.
media-trim-range.fits: Set in and out points, with excluded time still visible for orientation.

attachment-peek-release.title: Lift an attachment briefly and return it
attachment-peek-release.moves: One attachment rises and grows a little during a hold, then settles into exactly the original grid slot.
attachment-peek-release.fixed: Neighboring thumbnails and interface chrome hold position.
attachment-peek-release.notice: The viewer is temporarily inspecting an item before letting go, with no navigation or selection committed.
attachment-peek-release.fits: Show a transient peek and return to the same spatial context.

card-reorder-insert.title: Drag a photo into a new grid position
card-reorder-insert.moves: The lifted tile follows a path over the row, its neighbors shift into the vacated space, and it docks in the new order.
card-reorder-insert.fixed: The thumbnail row bounds, heading, and footer hold position.
card-reorder-insert.notice: The dragged item is now third and the displaced items keep their relative order.
card-reorder-insert.fits: Demonstrate a persistent order change in a set of editable media.

media-progressive-sharpen.title: Resolve a soft preview in successive regions
media-progressive-sharpen.moves: Successive bands sharpen over a soft version of the same photo.
media-progressive-sharpen.fixed: The picture geometry, window, heading, and footer hold position.
media-progressive-sharpen.notice: The visible asset is gaining detail rather than being replaced.
media-progressive-sharpen.fits: Show a deliberately staged placeholder-to-full-resolution transition.

media-caption-disclosure.title: Unfold a caption below a stationary photo
media-caption-disclosure.moves: The caption window gains height, the full caption appears, and the neighboring row below is pushed down.
media-caption-disclosure.fixed: The photo bounds, disclosure control, heading, and footer hold position.
media-caption-disclosure.notice: The caption is part of the photo’s layout and takes up real space.
media-caption-disclosure.fits: Expose longer notes while keeping the photo visible and preserving a coherent layout.

photo-iris-reveal.title: Reveal a photograph through an expanding aperture
photo-iris-reveal.moves: A circular mask expands from a chosen point and opens to all four corners of the frame.
photo-iris-reveal.fixed: The underlying picture geometry, reveal origin, crop frame, and interface chrome hold position.
photo-iris-reveal.notice: The first detail appears at the chosen point; its surroundings are revealed from the same unmoving image.
photo-iris-reveal.fits: Reveal one image outward from an editorial focal point after a hold.

album-page-turn.title: Turn one album leaf across a visible spine
album-page-turn.moves: The departing right leaf compresses toward the seam; its reverse side opens over the left page.
album-page-turn.fixed: The album cover and center seam hold position, and content on resting pages has no free translation.
album-page-turn.notice: The viewer advances to the next spread by turning one physical leaf.
album-page-turn.fits: Present an album as a book; this is a flat hinge projection with shadow, without a rolling paper deformation.

photo-grid-density.title: Reflow the same photo tiles into a denser grid
photo-grid-density.moves: Existing images shrink and converge to new rows and columns while secondary tiles appear in the now reachable cells.
photo-grid-density.fixed: The grid region, headings, and footer hold position.
photo-grid-density.notice: The same album now shows more thumbnails per row while preserving item identity and order.
photo-grid-density.fits: Preview a grid density change, keeping the first four image identities across both states.

attachment-download-progress.title: Track transfer progress to a usable attachment
attachment-download-progress.moves: A determinate progress bar fills with two pauses; the status becomes available only at completion.
attachment-download-progress.fixed: The attachment thumbnail, filename, card geometry, and interface chrome hold position.
attachment-download-progress.notice: The item is still transferring until it reaches completion.
attachment-download-progress.fits: Show a measured percentage advancing toward an openable attachment.

photo-markup-stroke.title: Draw a markup stroke over a stationary photo
photo-markup-stroke.moves: A curved annotation accumulates in drawing order with the pen tip moving along the growing stroke.
photo-markup-stroke.fixed: The photograph, viewport, heading, and footer hold position.
photo-markup-stroke.notice: The markup singles out a region while keeping the underlying photo visible.
photo-markup-stroke.fits: Direct attention with a hand-drawn path that remains at the end of the move.

location-question-bridge.title: Hold the location question while switching from keyboard to map
location-question-bridge.moves: The lower camera pushes toward a location control; the keyboard and composer clear, and a map occupies their former region.
location-question-bridge.fixed: The question remains the readable anchor. It nudges with the camera push, then holds through the change of surfaces.
location-question-bridge.notice: The map is the direct answer to the same location question, and the empty interval gives the change room to read.
location-question-bridge.fits: Carry a specific question across composer action and visual answer, retaining the question as the bridge.

screen-to-physical-prop.title: Pass attention from a phone reply to a physical prop
screen-to-physical-prop.moves: The phone falls away to the left and loses focus as the physical prop on the right sharpens. The camera cuts to a tighter continuation, pushes in a little farther, then holds.
screen-to-physical-prop.fixed: The prop stays put on the table. The reply and its conversation layout move together with the phone.
screen-to-physical-prop.notice: The reply names something that exists outside the phone, and the tighter shot confirms it is the same physical object.
screen-to-physical-prop.fits: Use when a readable message identifies a physical object and the next beat needs the audience to recognize that object in the real scene.

metric-count.title: Count between totals in place
metric-count.moves: Only the numeric value steps through intermediate whole numbers, then the final value holds.
metric-count.fixed: The heading, metric label, optional unit and field stay in place.
metric-count.notice: Readable growth or reduction on one comparable measure while the label retains its meaning.
metric-count.fits: Count one metric up or down between known endpoints without scrolling its digits.

text-scramble-resolve.title: Resolve shifting glyphs to one fixed title
text-scramble-resolve.moves: Unsettled character slots change while their positions stay fixed, then resolve into a readable title left to right.
text-scramble-resolve.fixed: The title field, heading and camera hold steady.
text-scramble-resolve.notice: A title changes from unreadable to definite without moving the reading position.
text-scramble-resolve.fits: A short decode, establishment or reveal where delayed legibility is intentional.

center-gutter-open.title: Part two images to reveal the center
center-gutter-open.moves: Two separate picture planes slide outward in opposite directions and open a gutter for a label.
center-gutter-open.fixed: The original frame and revealed text stay centered.
center-gutter-open.notice: Two distinct views make room for a shared conclusion between them.
center-gutter-open.fits: The pair and the central conclusion should remain simultaneously visible.

hinged-swatch-fan.title: Fan and hold swatches around a shared pin
hinged-swatch-fan.moves: The outer leaves rotate in opposite directions around a common pin and stop in a standing fan.
hinged-swatch-fan.fixed: The center leaf, visible pivot, heading and camera are fixed.
hinged-swatch-fan.notice: The surfaces are variants of the same collection and share a single attachment point.
hinged-swatch-fan.fits: Reveal three material or visual samples simultaneously around an anchored pivot.
